items.title: Special Weather Statement issued May 11 at 6:46AM CDT by NWS Duluth MN
items.summary:
Dry conditions will lead to near critical
fire weather conditions today. Minimum relative humidity values of
18 to 29 percent are expected. These conditions could lead to the
rapid spread of fires. Check burning restrictions and fire danger
before burning.

For more information on burning restrictions for Minnesota, see
www.dnr.state.mn.us/forestry/fire/firerating_restrictions.html.
